Condition screening

These conditions were mined from the prescription text of the matrix. A definitive No moves the matching clauses to an audited "screened out" section instead of leaving them in your conditional pile. Clauses that apply when a condition is absent (e.g., 52.204-5 on unrestricted awards) are handled with reversed logic automatically.
